name: Underwater Electronic Systems
description: Introduction; underwater acoustic communication – applications: modulation and coding schemes, propagation considerations, equalizers, link budget, diversity. MIMO: underwater acoustic vector sensors – principles, types, design, calibration, direction of arrival estimation, directivity index. High-resolution imaging – side-scan sonar, synthetic aperture sonar. CTFM sonar: doppler velocity log, source localization methods.
